system.description:
Scout-Nin Keyword: Specialized

As an action, you can spend one superiority die, targeting all creatures of your choice within 30 feet of you. All selected creatures must make a Wisdom or Intelligence saving throw (Your choice) vs your Ninjutsu (or Genjutsu save DC). On a failed save they become unable to Disengage and unable to willingly lie to you or creatures allied with you for the next minute.
